$comment: Market metadata, bilingual categories/labels, and optional per-plugin overrides. Package names must match entries in plugins.txt (or packages discovered from Git repos).

description.en: A curated, format-1 compliant plugin index for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Community discovery credited to dsh.so.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 的精选 Format 1 插件索引，覆盖工作台、上下文洞察、联网搜索、长期记忆、交互式 UI 与远程访问。社区插件发现参考 dsh.so。

description.en: Multi-engine web search and fetch plugin for DeepSeek Harness with zero-config free backends (DuckDuckGo, Bing, etc.), smart routing, and fallback priority.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的多引擎免费联网搜索与抓取插件，开箱支持 DuckDuckGo、Bing 等免密钥后端，内置智能路由、语言池与故障自动降级。

description.en: Render interactive UI components inline in assistant replies via dsh-ui code fences — charts, forms, quizzes, Mermaid diagrams, and 3D scenes with action callbacks to the model.
description.zh: 通过 dsh-ui 代码围栏在助手回复中内联渲染图表、表单、测验、Mermaid 流程图与 3D 场景等交互式 UI，并支持将用户操作事件回传给模型。
